jobs.occupation: Inetum - Business Consultant Manufacturing & Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

 
• As part of the development of the Industry sector team with a focus on manufacturing & supply chain, we are looking to strengthen the team.
 
• You will participate in on both client activities as internal activities supporting the growth of our Industry sector team within Inetum Consulting:
  
   
• We are interested in people with proven track records in delivering mid-large scale digital projects linked to manufacturing & supply chain topics.
   
• We believe in people we hire, we encourage people to take ownership by given them the right support, environment and tools to be successful at Inetum.
  
 
• You will execute & leading project assignments, including, data analysis, benchmarks, interviews, workshop animation, process mapping, business analysis, implementation roadmaps etc.
 
• Following the assignment, you will take up team lead roles.
 
• You will get the opportunity to contribute actively within the Industry Sector team to support the growth, expand our offering in manufacturing and supply chain and participate to seminars, publications,....
 
• Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to collaborate within the Inetum Consulting global business line:
  
   
• Carrying out projects to improve operational performance
   
• Assisting the project owner or Program Manager on major digital transformation programmes
   
• Strategic framing and optimisation...
  
...

• You have at least 3 years of experience in the manufacturing or supply chain industry gained within a consulting firm focused on Operations Excellence.

• You have actively participated in cross-functional projects to improve operational excellence.

• Your experience, skills, and communication abilities allow you to manage project teams at our key clients.

• Your ability to propose solutions enables you to assert yourself on high-value-added business topics with Industrial and General Management.

• An interest in ERP tools, MES solutions and Industry 4.0 technologies is a differentiating plus.

• You are fluent in Dutch or French and English and proficient in Dutch or French at least professionally, allowing you to conduct workshops in an international environment.

You will join an international finance environment with operations across several European countries. Based in the Brussels region, the accounting team supports multiple entities and works closely with controlling, business finance, and external advisors. English serves as the primary working language.

This Senior Accountant position goes beyond traditional accounting. You will take on a central role in the month-end closing process, bring structure to complex accounting operations, and have the opportunity to drive digitalization, automation, and process improvement initiatives.

Senior accountant - Job omschrijving

• You independently manage the month-end closing process, maintain oversight of the end-to-end accounting cycle, and contribute to the development of an efficient finance organization.
• You lead process improvement initiatives across accounting, reporting, and audit activities, while actively supporting digitalization, automation, and optimization projects.
• You act as a key business partner for colleagues and external stakeholders, analyze financial risks, and support complex matters related to taxation, reporting, and international operations.

Senior accountant - Profiel

• You have 5 to 7 years of experience in accounting, audit, consulting, or a similar financial environment, with proven exposure to complex closing processes.
• You combine a strong knowledge of Belgian accounting legislation with the maturity and autonomy required to manage financial processes and dossiers independently.
• You are a hands-on generalist who takes initiative, identifies improvement opportunities, and enjoys taking ownership within an international environment.

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 
airline and MICE guests. 
Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 
it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll doYou'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 
• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 
• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 
• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 
• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 
• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 
• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 
• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 
• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 
• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 
• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 
• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 
• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:  

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools.  

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues.  

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise.  

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).  

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities:

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

Are you an experienced Wintel System Engineer with a passion for Microsoft infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments? Do you enjoy taking technical ownership, solving complex infrastructure challenges and helping customers modernize their IT environments?

At Inetum, we're looking for a hands-on Wintel System Engineer to strengthen our infrastructure expertise and support our customers in transforming and optimizing their Microsoft environments.

In this role, you'll work on challenging infrastructure projects, with a strong focus on Windows Server technologies, Active Directory, SQL Server platforms and hybrid cloud environments.

You'll be involved in the entire project lifecycle, from technical analysis and planning to implementation, migration, validation and documentation.

Your key responsibilities:

• Design, implement, maintain and optimize Microsoft-based infrastructure environments.
• Lead and execute end-to-end server migrations, including Windows Server upgrades and infrastructure modernization projects.
• Manage and migrate Active Directory environments, including domain migrations, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies and authentication services.
• Implement and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including platform upgrades, Always On Availability Groups and Windows Failover Clustering.
• Perform application and file server migrations, ensuring business continuity and minimal downtime.
• Work with hybrid infrastructure environments, combining on-premises Microsoft technologies with cloud-based solutions.
• Prepare and execute migration strategies, including cutover planning, rollback scenarios and post-migration validation.
• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide sustainable technical solutions.
• Collaborate directly with customers, understand their technical requirements and take ownership of project delivery.
• Deliver clear technical documentation, as-built documentation and knowledge transfer to operational teams.
You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking responsibility for your projects while collaborating with specialized experts whenever specific technical challenges require additional expertise.

Do you have a strong technical background in Microsoft infrastructure and several years of hands-on experience?

Your technical expertise includes:

• Windows Server: Extensive experience with Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022 and preferably 2025.
• Active Directory: Strong knowledge of AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) and FSMO roles.
• Security & Authentication: Understanding of Kerberos, service accounts, authentication mechanisms and Microsoft PKI / Certificate Services.
• SQL Server: Experience with SQL Server 2019/2022, Always On Availability Groups and SQL platform migrations.
• High Availability: Knowledge of Windows Failover Clustering and business-critical infrastructure environments.
• Microsoft Infrastructure Services: Experience with IIS, File Services, DFS, NTFS permissions, Remote Desktop Services (RDS) and RemoteApp.
• Virtualization: Operational knowledge of VMware vSphere.
• Hybrid Cloud: Good understanding of hybrid Microsoft infrastructure environments and their integration with cloud technologies.
• Migration Projects: Proven experience with end-to-end server, domain, application and file server migrations.
• Project Delivery: Experience with migration planning, cutover execution, rollback strategies, technical validation and documentation.
And are you…

• An experienced Wintel Engineer with approximately 5–10+ years of relevant experience?
• A hands-on technical expert who enjoys taking ownership from start to finish?
• Comfortable independently managing complex infrastructure migrations?
• Strong in troubleshooting, root cause analysis and problem-solving?
• Someone who combines technical expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset?
• A clear communicator who enjoys working directly with customers and technical stakeholders?
• Structured in your approach, with attention to documentation, knowledge sharing and quality?
• A team player who knows when to involve specialized expertise?
• Fluent in Dutch and English, with French as an additional asset?
Then you might be the Wintel System Engineer we're looking for!

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior Azure / .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We're reimagining a mission-critical communication platform that powers how systems exchange data, files, and events with the outside world. This is not a greenfield toy project-it's a high-impact transformation at scale.

As a Senior Azure .NET Architect, you'll help design and shape a next-generation, cloud-native integration platform. You'll take an existing, complex ecosystem and turn it into a resilient, high-performance, event-driven architecture running on Azure.

If you enjoy solving hard distributed systems problems and building platforms that truly matter-this role is for you.
💡 What you'll be doing

You won't just "contribute"-you'll shape the future architecture:

• Design and build a modern communication layer handling message and file ingestion, transformation, routing, and delivery (sync + async)

• Create resilient, fault-tolerant systems using proven patterns like retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and event-driven workflows

• Architect scalable event-driven solutions using Azure messaging services and/or Kafka-style pub/sub systems

• Build high-quality .NET services (.NET 7/8, C#, ASP.NET Core, gRPC/REST) with a strong engineering culture (TDD, clean code, performance-first)

• Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes (AKS/OpenShift) using Helm and modern CI/CD pipelines

• Define observability from day one: logging, tracing, metrics, SLOs, and actionable runbooks

• Collaborate in a truly agile setup, working closely with engineers, product owners, and other teams

• Mentor and elevate others-your experience will help raise the bar across the team

🎯 Why this role stands out

• High impact: You're building a core platform that everything depends on

• Real engineering challenges: Distributed systems, scalability, resilience-no trivial work here

• Modern tech stack: Cloud-native, Kubernetes, event-driven, .NET latest

• Ownership & influence: Your architectural decisions will shape the platform long-term

• Collaborative culture: Work with experienced engineers who care about doing things right

• Extensive experience in software engineering (15+ years), including building distributed, high-throughput, or mission-critical systems

• Strong hands-on Azure expertise (AKS, Functions, messaging services, Storage, monitoring, CI/CD)

• Deep knowledge of .NET (C#, modern .NET, async programming, testing practices)

• Solid understanding of event-driven architecture and distributed system trade-offs

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments

• A mindset focused on quality, automation, and continuous improvement

• Confidence to make architectural decisions and guide others

• Strong communication skills in English

 

🌟 bonus points:

• Experience with observability stacks (Opentelemetry, tracing, logging platforms)

• Exposure to large-scale messaging or file transfer systems

• Knowledge of secure integration protocols (e.g., sFTP, AS2/AS4, messaging queues)

• Experience working in regulated or high-reliability environments
